verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's AI Gateway is documented as a gateway layer with caching, rate limiting, retries, model fallback and usage/cost metrics, started with one line of code. Workers AI offers inference via one API call, but its catalog is cited as 50+ open-source models, not hundreds. Missing for 10: evidence of access to hundreds of models, explicit documentation of a single unified endpoint spanning multiple third-party providers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
